messages:
mira: Heads-up — postmortem for the Valen Dedicated outage is up. Main findings: transient cross-site gateway flap + a leftover on-prem ACL that blocked BGP fallback. Need owners for follow-ups.

mira: Quick action list we sketched: 
1) config validator for VPC peering to catch mismatched ASNs/cidrs
2) on-prem ACL runbook + owner (include rollback steps)
3) regression test in e2e to catch route-leak/isolation bugs
4) tweak alerts for cross-site gateway flaps (reduce noisy pages)

sam: I'll take #1 — build a lightweight validator that compares desired peering state vs actual. ETA Thu COB.

raj: I'll own #2 (on-prem ACL runbook). Need Valen network diagrams and the last approved ACLs. @kelly can you share?

kelly: Shared diagram link: https://redwood.internal/valen/network-diagram.pdf :eyes: Also uploaded the last ACL export to the secure bucket.

opsbot: New task created: OPS-4721 assigned to raj, due 2026-03-30.

mira: For #3, prefer eng-platform to own since CI needs a deterministic harness that simulates BGP-less fallback and edge isolation. @sam possible?

sam: Yep, I can do the regression harness. Plan: add a deterministic fail-case that simulates route removal and validates fallback behavior. WIP PR by Tue.

sam: validator sketch (quick proof-of-concept):
```
# peering sanity check
curl -s "https://api.redwood/internal/peers?customer=valen" | jq '.peers[] | {peer_id, local_asn, remote_asn, cidr}'
```

raj: Quick discovery — Valen had an ACL line `deny any 172.16.0.0/12` that was overly broad. Looks like a leftover from an old VPN carveout. I've noted it in the runbook draft.

kelly: Confirmed with Valen's network team — that line was added during a migration in 2023 and never trimmed. They'll sign off on the change if we include a rollback plan.

mira: Timeline goal: close critical remediations (validator + ACL fix + regression test) by next Friday. Docs/runbooks can be sprint-queued if not blocking. Anyone blocking?

sam: No blockers from my side. Might ask infra for a sandbox endpoint to run the harness.

raj: Need approval to rotate the on-prem creds before I apply ACL changes. @mira can you sign off when I attach the PR and justification?

mira: I will sign. Please attach the rotation plan and post rotation verification steps in the PR; I'll approve by EOD.

deploy-bot: CI: test-harness pipeline started for PR #482 (sam). Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/4482 — sandbox deploy queued.

mira: Also proposal: schedule a recurring 90-day audit for peering configs for Dedicated customers. Action: propose cadence + owner in 2 weeks.

kelly: I'll draft the audit template and checklist (peer ASNs, allowed cidrs, ACL diffs, smoke test endpoints).

sam: One small ops tweak: let's add a signal that correlates BGP flaps with recent config pushes; that should reduce time-to-blame. I'll add a Grafana panel.

mira: Great. I'll consolidate these into the postmortem follow-up tracker and update the PM/CS notes so Valen sees the remediation timeline.

raj: Noted — OPS-4721 will include the runbook link and the ACL diff.

mira: Thanks all. I'll run a quick sync on Friday 11:00 to check progress. If anything slips, flag here. :thumbsup:
